boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on Calkins, Jefferson, East Henrietta, and Martin roads in RIT’s Henrietta-area orbit, each with a documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Veterans Memorial Park for the fitness trail
cards.subtitle: Calkins Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the Calkins Road entrance to reach the 3/4-mile fitness trail, then continue to the park’s Lehigh Valley Trail connection.
cards.short_summary: A town park with a fitness trail and trail connection.
cards.evidence_claim: Veterans Memorial Park at 595 Calkins Road has a 3/4-mile fitness trail and access to the Lehigh Valley Trail.
cards.access_notes: Town page lists park hours as 7 a.m.–10 p.m., seven days a week.

cards.title: Henrietta Public Library for a community-room stop
cards.subtitle: Calkins Road corridor
cards.notes: Check the library calendar before heading over; its Community Room hosts the public Library Board meetings listed by the town.
cards.short_summary: A municipal-complex library with a documented community meeting room.
cards.evidence_claim: Henrietta Public Library is at 625 Calkins Road, and the town lists Library Board meetings in its Community Room.
cards.access_notes: Verify library hours and individual program availability before visiting.

cards.title: Henrietta Recreation Center for scheduled activities
cards.subtitle: Calkins Road corridor
cards.notes: Look at the town recreation calendar for an activity that fits your visit; the center is the listed site for town youth programming.
cards.short_summary: A town recreation destination used for scheduled programs.
cards.evidence_claim: The Henrietta Recreation Center is at 605 Calkins Road and is the listed location for Youth Development Advisory Committee meetings.
cards.source_title: Youth Development Advisory Committee | Henrietta NY
cards.access_notes: Programs and entry requirements vary; check the town calendar first.

cards.title: Henrietta Town Hall for public-meeting access
cards.subtitle: Calkins Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the published Town Board schedule if you want to attend a civic meeting, and review the agenda before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A municipal meeting destination on Calkins Road.
cards.evidence_claim: Henrietta Town Hall is at 475 Calkins Road, and the town states that the public may speak at Town Board meetings.
cards.source_title: Contacting the Town Board | Henrietta NY
cards.access_notes: Meeting dates, rooms, and public-comment procedures can change; confirm with the town.

cards.title: Tinker Nature Park for its walking trails
cards.subtitle: Calkins Road corridor
cards.notes: Start from the Calkins Road side and choose either the 1.2-mile walking/exercise trail or the half-mile nature trail.
cards.short_summary: A 68-acre town nature park with two documented trail options.
cards.evidence_claim: Tinker Nature Park at 1525 Calkins Road has a 1.2-mile walking/exercise trail and a half-mile nature trail.
cards.access_notes: The town lists the park as open daily from 7 a.m. until dusk; pets are not permitted.

cards.title: Hansen Nature Center for natural-history displays
cards.subtitle: Calkins Road corridor at Tinker Nature Park
cards.notes: Pair a trail visit with the center’s New York natural-history displays, and arrive before the listed last-admission time.
cards.short_summary: A free-admission nature center within Tinker Nature Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Hansen Nature Center features New York natural-history displays, offers year-round classes, and states that admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Town page lists Tuesday–Saturday hours, 9 a.m.–4 p.m., with last admission at 3:45 p.m.

cards.title: Tinker Homestead for the cobblestone farm museum
cards.subtitle: Calkins Road corridor at Tinker Nature Park
cards.notes: Call ahead to arrange a tour, then focus on the restored homestead and farm implements that interpret regional agricultural change.
cards.short_summary: A restored 1830 cobblestone homestead and farm museum.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tinker Homestead & Farm Museum includes an 1830 cobblestone farm and displays farm implements; tours are available by appointment.
cards.source_title: Tinker Homestead & Farm Museum | Henrietta NY
cards.access_notes: Tours are listed by appointment Tuesday–Saturday, 10 a.m.–2 p.m.; call before visiting.

cards.title: Lookup Park for disc golf and the dog park
cards.subtitle: East Henrietta Road corridor
cards.notes: Bring the gear appropriate to your plan: the town’s park listing identifies both a short disc-golf course and a dog park here.
cards.short_summary: A town park with short disc golf, dog-park, and driving-range amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: Lookup Park at 3850 East Henrietta Road is listed with a dog park, a short disc-golf course, and a golf driving range.
cards.access_notes: Confirm individual amenity conditions with Henrietta Parks and Recreation.

cards.title: Martin Road Park for courts and a fishing pond
cards.subtitle: Martin Road corridor
cards.notes: Choose a court, field, or the catch-and-release pond; the town specifically prohibits swimming in the pond.
cards.short_summary: An 80-acre town park with courts, fields, and catch-and-release fishing.
cards.evidence_claim: Martin Road Park at 1344 Martin Road has a catch-and-release fishing pond, soccer field, and tennis/pickleball courts.
cards.access_notes: Town page lists hours from 7 a.m. until sunset, seven days a week; no swimming in the pond.

cards.title: Genesee Valley Regional Market for its tenant directory
cards.subtitle: Jefferson Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the authority’s tenant directory to identify a specific business before you go; the market property is a large multi-tenant site.
cards.short_summary: A 190-company regional market property on Jefferson Road.
cards.evidence_claim: The Genesee Valley Regional Market Authority at 900 Jefferson Road reports that 190 companies do business on its Henrietta and Chili property.
cards.source_title: Genesee Valley Regional Market Authority | Rochester, NY
cards.access_notes: Authority contact page lists Monday–Friday hours of 7 a.m.–5 p.m.; individual tenants may differ.
